title: Lula May Meet with New York City Mayor During UN Visit
seoTitle: Lula and NYC Mayor May Meet
subtitle: Foreign Ministry Confirms Details of President's Trip to 81st UN Assembly
excerpt: Brazil's Foreign Ministry announced that President Lula will travel to New York for the 81st UN General Assembly and may meet with the city's mayor during his visit.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazil's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MRE) announced on Wednesday (16) the details of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's trip to the 81st United Nations (UN) General Assembly in New York (USA) next week.

According to the statement, there is a possibility that the Brazilian president will meet with the Mayor of New York City during his stay. The meeting, which is yet to be confirmed, would be part of Lula's official mission agenda to the country.

The official visit's objective includes participation in the UN General Assembly session, which brings together heads of state and government from around the world to discuss global issues. The potential meeting with the Mayor of New York would serve as an additional moment for bilateral dialogue within this international context.

With information from Agência Brasil.
